title: Bound JasonShell Shell and Process Icon Caches
description: Bound JasonShell shell/process icon caches with an LRU or size-cap policy. Problem: FN-004 found stack icon and process icon caches are process-lifetime HashMaps keyed by paths/executables without explicit caps, risking steady-state memory growth after browsing many folders/processes. Target metric: cap steady-state cache memory while preserving cache hit performance. Likely file scope: `src-tauri/src/stack_popup/icons.rs`, `src-tauri/src/process_manager.rs`, related tests. Acceptance criteria: configurable/constants-based caps are added; cache hits remain lock-light; eviction behavior is unit-tested; large-folder/process-manager smoke demonstrates no correctness regressions; before/after cache-size behavior is documented.

steps.name: Add a bounded cache policy for Stack Browser shell icons
Add a bounded cache policy for Process Manager process icons

log.outcome: The specification is clear, correctly scoped, and targets the actual unbounded icon-cache patterns present in the codebase. It explicitly preserves the important concurrency contract: cache hits under short mutex scopes and shell icon extraction outside cache locks. Testing and documentation requirements are concrete and verifiable.
